title: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico with 155 mph winds and flooding fears - NPR
description: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.
